verdict.rationale: Entitlements are a fair axis for a billing platform like Metronome, but the evidence pack never describes modeling features or limits as entitlements on plans, or any API or SDK call to check a customer's entitlements at runtime. The closest mentions are credit-based 'gated access when credits run out' and threshold webhooks. Neither is an entitlement model or a runtime check, so the general SDK and API docs cannot be credited for this story.
